Update multiple objects from a YAML file.

The file should contain a YAML array of update items:
  - id: BLI-001
    updates:
      title: "Updated Title"
      status: validated
  - id: BLI-002
    updates:
      priority: high


  Update multiple objects from file
  zqk-object object bulk update --file updates.yaml
  Dry-run to see what would be updated
  zqk-object object bulk update --file updates.yaml --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk-object object bulk update [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run       Show what would be done without actually doing it
      --file string   Path to YAML file containing array of updates (required)
      --force         Force mode: skip 'not found' errors (treat missing objects as success)
      --keep-file     Keep the source file after update (default: temp files like tmp-*.yaml are removed automatically)
      --relaxed       Relax integrity constraints during bulk update (allow references to objects that will be created later in batch operations). Note: Auto-detected for bulk operations, this flag is optional.
